blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Flags ₹87,124 Crore as Difficult-to-Recover Dues in FY26 (Up 12%). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Highlights regulatory enforcement recovery challenges despite record annual fee collections.
SEBI Fee Revenue: Total fee income rose 10% to ₹2,563 crore (stock exchange regulatory fees generated ₹1,349 crore).
Investor Protection Fund (IPF): Fund balance rose to ₹965 crore; investor education spend stood at ₹2.25 crore.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
